name: Aengus the Wanderer (CR 1)
body:
The half-elf man before you is clad in studded leather armor. He carries a shortspear and a light crossbow, plus a pack and various other tools. He is handsome but shows obvious signs of spending much time out-of-doors.
Aengus the Wanderer	CR 1

XP 400
Male half-elf expert 3
NG Medium humanoid
Init +0; Senses low-light vision; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 10, flat-footed 13 (+3 armor, +0 Dex)
hp 17 (3d8+3)
Fort +2, Ref +1, Will +2; +2 vs. enchantment
Immune sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee shortspear +2 (1d6)
Ranged masterwork light crossbow +3 (1d8/19-20)

TACTICS

Aegnus isn’t much of a tactician or warrior. He prefers to avoid confrontation via stealth and careful planning.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 10, Con 12, Int 13, Wis 8, Cha 11
Base Atk +2; CMB +2; CMD 12
Feats Self-Sufficient, Skill Focus (Profession [furrier])B, Stealthy
Skills Craft (woodworking) +7, Escape Artist +8, Heal +7, Knowledge (nature) +7, Perception +7, Profession (furrier) +8, Stealth +8, Survival +7; Racial Modifiers +2 Perception
Languages Common, Elven, Sylvan

Aengus the Wanderer is a loner, a furrier and woodsman who spends most of his time searching the woods and hills around his cabin for the fey woman with whom he fell hopelessly in love after a brief meeting.
More of Aengus’s story can be found in Quid Novi? 8, the April 18th issue of Spes Magna’s twice-monthly newsletter. You can learn more about Spes Magna Games at our Facebook Fan Page and our company website.

ECOLOGY

Treasure potion of cure light wounds, potion of shield of faith +2, spear, masterwork light crossbow with 20 bolts, masterwork studded leather, various wilderness survival items
